panels.title: 月別 共同支出（カテゴリ積み上げ）（円）

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT month AS "月", SUM(CASE WHEN category='電気' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "電気", SUM(CASE WHEN category='水道' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "水道", SUM(CASE WHEN category='ガス' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "ガス", SUM(CASE WHEN category='食費' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "食費", SUM(CASE WHEN category='外食' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "外食", SUM(CASE WHEN category='ビール' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "ビール", SUM(CASE WHEN category='日用品' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "日用品", SUM(CASE WHEN category='交通費' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "交通費", SUM(CASE WHEN category='旅行' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "旅行", SUM(CASE WHEN category='家具' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "家具", SUM(CASE WHEN category='その他' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "その他" FROM household_entries WHERE kind='共同' AND month >= strftime('%Y-%m','now','localtime','-12 months') GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
targets.queryText: SELECT month AS "月", SUM(CASE WHEN category='電気' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "電気", SUM(CASE WHEN category='水道' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "水道", SUM(CASE WHEN category='ガス' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "ガス", SUM(CASE WHEN category='食費' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "食費", SUM(CASE WHEN category='外食' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "外食", SUM(CASE WHEN category='ビール' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "ビール", SUM(CASE WHEN category='日用品' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "日用品", SUM(CASE WHEN category='交通費' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "交通費", SUM(CASE WHEN category='旅行' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "旅行", SUM(CASE WHEN category='家具' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "家具", SUM(CASE WHEN category='その他' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "その他" FROM household_entries WHERE kind='共同' AND month >= strftime('%Y-%m','now','localtime','-12 months') GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT month AS "月", SUM(CASE WHEN category='電気' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "電気", SUM(CASE WHEN category='水道' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "水道", SUM(CASE WHEN category='ガス' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "ガス" FROM household_entries WHERE category IN ('電気','水道','ガス') AND month >= strftime('%Y-%m','now','localtime','-12 months') GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT month AS "月",
  SUM(CASE WHEN kind='共同' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "共同支出",
  SUM(CASE WHEN kind='共同' AND payer='智史' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "共同 智史払い",
  SUM(CASE WHEN kind='共同' AND payer='香琳' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "共同 香琳払い",
  SUM(CASE WHEN kind IN ('個別','調整') AND payer='智史' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "立て替え 智史",
  SUM(CASE WHEN kind IN ('個別','調整') AND payer='香琳' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "立て替え 香琳",
  SUM(CASE WHEN kind='振込' THEN delta ELSE 0 END) AS "振込",
  SUM(delta) AS "残高変動"
FROM household_entries GROUP BY month ORDER BY month DESC
targets.queryText:
SELECT month AS "月",
  SUM(CASE WHEN kind='共同' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "共同支出",
  SUM(CASE WHEN kind='共同' AND payer='智史' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "共同 智史払い",
  SUM(CASE WHEN kind='共同' AND payer='香琳' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "共同 香琳払い",
  SUM(CASE WHEN kind IN ('個別','調整') AND payer='智史' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "立て替え 智史",
  SUM(CASE WHEN kind IN ('個別','調整') AND payer='香琳' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "立て替え 香琳",
  SUM(CASE WHEN kind='振込' THEN delta ELSE 0 END) AS "振込",
  SUM(delta) AS "残高変動"
FROM household_entries GROUP BY month ORDER BY month DESC

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT item AS "店舗", COUNT(*) AS "件数", SUM(amount) AS "金額（円）" FROM household_entries WHERE source='receipt' GROUP BY item ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT date AS "日付", CASE source WHEN 'receipt' THEN 'レシート' ELSE '手入力' END AS "入力", item AS "内容", category AS "カテゴリ", kind AS "種別", payer AS "支払者", transfer_to AS "振込先", amount AS "金額（円）", delta AS "残高変動（円）", memo AS "メモ", ref AS "参照" FROM household_entries ORDER BY date DESC, ref DESC LIMIT 200
